name: Retro Cyberpunk Neon Pixel v1

renderLock.palette: limited palette (<= 24 colors), 2-3 shade cel shading, neon accents on dark base
renderLock.lighting: neon glow must be represented with hard-edged pixel clusters (no bloom/blur)
renderLock.environment: retro cyberpunk / neon-noir nighttime city mood

outputLock.framing: square composition, keep safe margins for UI overlays
outputLock.notes: scene illustration (not plain background sprite), still true pixel art

promptFixedBlock:
[STYLE LOCK — Retro Cyberpunk Neon Pixel v001]
Render as TRUE 2D pixel art: crisp pixels, NO anti-aliasing, NO blur, NO smooth gradients, NO dithering.
Use nearest-neighbor upscale look (as if painted at low resolution, then scaled up).
Limited palette (<= 24 colors), simple 2-3 shade cel shading, dark 1px outline for major silhouettes.
Retro cyberpunk / neon-noir: nighttime city mood, neon lights, wet reflections.
Neon glow must be represented with hard-edged pixel clusters (NO bloom, NO blur).
No text, no readable letters or numbers, no watermark, no logo, no signature.

[OUTPUT LOCK]
1024x1024 (square). Leave safe margins for UI overlays.
promptNegative: anti-aliasing, blur, bloom, glow blur, smooth gradients, dithering, painterly rendering, photorealistic textures, noisy texture, text, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, signature, illegible typography

notes.usage: Use for scene CG/background cards matching a retro cyberpunk neon mood, while preserving true pixel-art constraints.
notes.compatibility: Can be combined with inline character identity anchors (XiaoYou/Kucha) to keep character consistency.
